name: Make Your Girlfriend Happy
source:
A short psychological horror visual novel where you try to make your girlfriend happy. Can you make the right choices and stay on her good side?

[Edited from [url=https://unicorncreates.itch.io/make-your-girlfriend-happy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部简短的心理恐怖视觉小说，你试图让你的女朋友开心。你能做出正确的选择并站在她一边吗？

[编辑自[url=https://unicorncreates.itch.io/make-your-girlfriend-happy]itch.io[/url]]
